assets.name: room-milk
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square environment backdrop for a premium Japanese ikebana arrangement editor, not a website mockup.
Primary request: Generate a single beautiful quiet Japanese wabi-sabi atelier interior, empty and ready for the user's flower arrangement. Morning window, milky white variant.
Style/medium: refined natural realism with a very subtle hand-painted / artful 3D illustration finish, tactile mineral plaster, elegant restrained composition.
Composition/framing: square 1:1, straight-on fixed frontal camera at tabletop height with a slightly downward view of the tabletop. The broad, empty matte pale limestone / pale ash wood tabletop begins at exactly y=79% of the image and fills the bottom 21%; horizontal table-back boundary must be extremely soft. The central 80% of width and central 75% of height must remain almost empty, calm milky plaster and softly diffused light, so later flowers will read cleanly. Only far left edge may hint at a blurred shoji window frame and only far upper-right edge may hint at a far distant garden; both barely perceptible. No strong framing architecture.
Lighting/mood: giant diffused window softbox from upper left, wrapped reflected light, luminous high-key milk white and warm cream, a trace of sage grey, smooth low contrast, no spotlight or bright beam shapes. The tabletop at center is evenly lit.
Constraints: absolutely no vase, no flowers, no plants in foreground, no objects, no people, no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. No hard outlines or strong shadows. No dark borders. Asset must be square and fill the image edge to edge, no frame.
This is background 1 of a coherent family; maintain table-back horizon at y=.79, front camera, subtle stylized realism, and large negative space.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied square milky Japanese ikebana atelier background. Keep the quiet soft plaster, gentle left shoji, distant right garden, frontal camera, palette and soft painterly realism unchanged. Only adjust the tabletop composition: move its soft wall/table boundary downward to y=79% of the frame (approximately 991 pixels in a 1254-pixel image), so the tabletop's upper surface fills only the bottom 21%. The table should continue entirely out of frame at the bottom; remove any visible vertical front lip/front face. Do not add any flowers, vase, objects, words, UI or hard shadows. Keep the same square canvas. Central area remains large empty negative space.

assets.name: vase-smoke-celadon
prompts:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: single isolated transparent ceramic vessel sprite for a beautiful Japanese ikebana game.
Primary request: one single exquisite Japanese wabi-sabi round-bellied small-mouth ceramic vase, warm matte smoky celadon / sage blue-grey, subtly handmade asymmetric wheel-thrown silhouette. A short very narrow neck opens into a softly rolled lip, dark interior opening visible as a small ellipse. Full object isolated with actual transparent alpha, not a photographed backdrop.
Style/medium: high-end restrained natural product realism with a subtle hand-painted / beautiful 3D art finish, fine ceramic microtexture and delicate mottled soft glaze, smooth continuous tonal modeling, tactile expensive ceramic.
Composition/framing: square image, front view very slightly from above so the small dark opening is visible. Centered vase occupies approximately 78% of image height, whole object including foot ring entirely visible, generous transparent margin. Round body with elegant balanced proportions; mouth width approximately 21% of maximum body width.
Lighting/mood: giant soft diffuse window from upper left, ample reflected fill from right, very gentle smooth rounded shading, matching a milky cream Japanese atelier; no hard contour highlight, no sharp shadow, no dramatic dark side.
Constraints: exactly one vase and nothing else. TRUE transparent alpha background. No tabletop, floor, cast ground shadow, pedestal, flower, leaf, stem, branch, water, accessory, character, text, UI, watermark, border or checkerboard painted into pixels. Do not crop object.

integration.coordinateNotes: Full square image, no cover crop or camera pan. Shared table-back horizon approximately 0.81. Existing vessel contact shadow stays a separate soft pass.
integration.selection: ambience.light/mood override top-level light/mood; moon or night uses room-moon; overcast or stone uses room-sage; morning/noon/default uses room-milk; dusk uses room-milk plus restrained warm soft-light grade.
integration.artNotes: Generated with built-in image_gen as individual assets. The corrected milk image fixes the camera and tabletop; sage and moon are matched lighting edits. Moon hard window streaks were removed in a second lighting edit. No additional programmatic window grid or sharp cast shadow is layered over these rooms.
integration.preloadNotes: Preload all three same-origin WebP images once and wait for decode before caching Unity background raster or exported artwork. Load failures resolve and paint a diffuse gradient fallback.
